components.name: Project Graph Builder
components.responsibility: Construct the typed code/doc graph of the repository (nodes, edges, provenance) from source and git state, serving as the shared substrate every downstream arena stage reads.

components.name: Project Encyclopedia
components.responsibility: Enrich the raw graph into a structured, queryable knowledge surface (symbols, sections, fingerprintable descriptors) consumed by the AI decomposer.

components.name: Project Snapshot
components.responsibility: Capture a deterministic, hashed snapshot of project state used to anchor decomposition and gating decisions to a fixed working-tree fingerprint.

components.name: AI Project Decomposer
components.responsibility: Drive the AI-first decomposition pipeline: assemble graph/encyclopedia/snapshot context, invoke the model adapter, and emit a Project Model of responsibility-bearing components rather than path buckets.

components.name: Project Model Gate
components.responsibility: Validate and admit emitted project models against snapshot identity and structural rules, rejecting non-deterministic or fabricated decompositions before acceptance.

components.name: Project Model CLI
components.responsibility: Provide the command-line entrypoint that wires graph construction and gating into an operator-runnable project-model workflow.

components.name: Hypothesis Engine
components.responsibility: Generate and select arena hypotheses using content fingerprints and a multi-armed-bandit policy, deduplicating candidates against the generated model surface.

components.name: Arena Execution Loop
components.responsibility: Orchestrate the iterative arena run: enforce the execution budget, advance phases, emit events, and bound divergence across the generated model surface.

contracts.name: Decomposer submits to Project Model Gate

cross_cutting_concerns.description: Every component and contract must trace to packet-supplied node/edge IDs and provenance; no responsibility, dependency, or check may be invented beyond observed graph evidence.
Decomposition and gating must be reproducible from a fixed snapshot; the packet reports git_dirty=true, so determinism is at risk until the working tree is committed and re-hashed.
All emitted artifacts must carry prov refs back to originating nodes/edges so the decomposition is auditable end-to-end.
Acceptance verification must run offline with no paid API calls; the AI decomposer's model invocation path must be excluded from or stubbed in the acceptance command.
Generated surfaces (arena/generated/models.py, schema.json, ddl.sql) are consumed by the loop and hypothesis engine but must not be treated as owned hypotheses; they are regenerated, not authored.
Protected surfaces under scorer/, verifier/, and schema/arena.yaml are excluded from arena ownership per non-goals; no component may claim or mutate them.
Generated surfaces are detected from git/filesystem truth and excluded from source component ownership.
Protected/oracle/scorer/schema surfaces are graph-visible but excluded from source ownership.

goal: decompose Build Arena into responsibility-bearing components without relying on path-classifier semantics

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Promote arena.project_model_llm into a standalone LLM-adapter component separate from the decomposer.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: The decomposer imports project_model_llm directly (edge:7e02ea209da7795bff6a) and is its only observed consumer, forming a single AI-first pipeline; splitting would create a one-file unit with no independent contract. Anchored to goal: decompose Build Arena into responsibility-bearing components without relying on path-classifier semantics; non-goals: do not accept file-bucket components; do not treat scorer verifier schema or generated files as owned arena hypotheses.

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Route the decomposer's graph access through the encyclopedia instead of the raw project_graph.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: The decomposer imports arena.project_graph directly (edge:52d0c53c037ed70393d0) in addition to the encyclopedia, so a direct graph contract is observed and not a transitive substitute. Anchored to goal: decompose Build Arena into responsibility-bearing components without relying on path-classifier semantics; non-goals: do not accept file-bucket components; do not treat scorer verifier schema or generated files as owned arena hypotheses.

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Attribute arena.budget to the Hypothesis Engine rather than the Execution Loop.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: Only arena.loop imports arena.budget (edge:0ad81c69fa74d4c0698e); the hypothesizer has no budget import edge, so budget belongs to the loop's execution responsibility. Anchored to goal: decompose Build Arena into responsibility-bearing components without relying on path-classifier semantics; non-goals: do not accept file-bucket components; do not treat scorer verifier schema or generated files as owned arena hypotheses.

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Treat the CLI as a direct fixture/report runner instead of an operator entrypoint into the AI-first decomposer.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: The goal requires a real decomposition pipeline, and the CLI import of arena.project_decomposer_ai shows the operator entrypoint delegates to the decomposer rather than bypassing it.

non_goals: do not treat scorer verifier schema or generated files as owned arena hypotheses

observable_checks.description: Project Graph construction is exercised by the test suite (graph imported under tests/test_project_snapshot_gate.py).
Project Encyclopedia behavior is covered by tests/test_project_encyclopedia.py.
Snapshot capture and model gating are jointly verified by tests/test_project_snapshot_gate.py (imports snapshot, gate, and graph).
AI Decomposer pipeline is covered by tests/test_project_decomposer_ai.py.
Fingerprint computation is verified by tests/test_fingerprints.py.
Execution loop, budget, and hypothesizer are jointly exercised by tests/test_loop_phase4.py.

verification_gaps.description: Project Model CLI has no observed tests/ import edge in the packet; its entrypoint wiring is unverified by the suite.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Add tests/test_project_model_cli.py that invokes the CLI argument parser and gate path, then assert it passes under 'uv run pytest tests -q'.

verification_gaps.description: arena.project_model_llm is reached only via the decomposer (edge:7e02ea209da7795bff6a) and has no direct test import; its model-adapter logic is not independently verified.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Add a unit test that stubs the model call and asserts project_model_llm prompt assembly and JSON parsing deterministically under 'uv run pytest tests -q'.

verification_gaps.description: surface_counts.generated=4 but only three generated nodes (models.py, schema.json, ddl.sql) appear in the packet; one generated surface is not represented or componentized.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Enumerate all generated surfaces in the snapshot and assert each is regenerable (not hand-edited) via a generation-drift check in 'uv run pytest tests -q'.

verification_gaps.description: Ten protected surfaces (scorer/*, verifier/*, schema/arena.yaml) are intentionally excluded from arena ownership per non-goals and therefore remain unverified by this decomposition.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Confirm via a boundary check that no arena component imports or writes protected surfaces, run inside 'uv run pytest tests -q'.

verification_gaps.description: git_dirty=true with many uncommitted arena/ and docs/ paths; this decomposition was derived from an uncommitted working tree and may not reproduce from a clean checkout.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Re-run decomposition and gating against a committed snapshot and assert identical project-model hash under 'uv run pytest tests -q'.
